sectors.name: Technology
themes: AI infrastructure buildout in Indonesia is creating durable demand for data center components, benefiting local distributors and US memory suppliers like WDC and MU.

Digitalization push in Indonesia's SME sector and government e-governance initiatives are driving sustained growth for local tech firms like MLPT and GPSO, independent of global cycles.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's tech rally, led by TRON and MLPT, signals strong momentum in AI and semiconductor plays. Capitalize on US-driven AI demand spillover to IDX-listed tech firms, particularly memory and storage plays like WDC and MU, as data center buildout accelerates.

sectors.name: Mining & Energy
themes: Indonesia's downstream nickel processing policy (hilirisasi) continues to drive value-add and attract foreign investment, creating durable earnings growth for integrated players like AMMN and BRMS.
Global copper supply constraints, exacerbated by energy transition electrification needs, structurally support prices and benefit Indonesian copper producers (FCX, DOID) with long-term mine life.
Rising domestic coal demand from new smelters and power plants, coupled with export diversification to India and China, provides a stable floor for coal miners (DEWA, CUAN) despite ESG headwinds.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's mining & energy sector shows strong momentum, led by nickel and copper plays (ALKA, DSSA, DEWA, CUAN, BRMS, AMMN) on China stimulus and EV demand optimism. Watch for sustained volume confirmation; US-linked FCX gains support global copper appetite. Position for downstream processing beneficiaries as Indonesia's resource nationalism and green energy transition accelerate structural demand for critical minerals.

Global hydrogen and battery storage supply chains are shifting toward Southeast Asia, benefiting PLUG and LAPD as Indonesia leverages its nickel and geothermal resources for integrated climate-tech ma
Rising corporate renewable purchase agreements and ESG mandates from Indonesian conglomerates are locking in long-term revenue visibility for IPPs like ARKO and CDIA, reducing project financing risk.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's renewables rally (+3.24%) signals policy tailwinds and capital rotation into domestic champions like ARKO (+18%) and CDIA (+9%), while US-listed PLUG (+6.57%) reflects global hydrogen momentum. Watch TPIA and BREN for sustained upside as Indonesia's energy transition accelerates, but remain selective on valuations.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Rising middle-class consumption in Indonesia drives demand for branded FMCG and protein products, supported by urbanization and digital penetration.
Government policies promoting food self-sufficiency and local sourcing benefit domestic producers like AGAR and BEEF, reducing import dependency.
Formal retail expansion and e-commerce growth in Indonesia create distribution advantages for FMCG players with strong brand equity and rural reach.
sectors.ai: Indonesia consumer/FMCG outperformed (+0.81% ID) vs US (-0.43%), with strong gains in AGAR, BEEF, COCO, and others signaling resilient domestic demand. Focus on companies with pricing power and local supply chains to capture structural consumption growth, as global headwinds remain muted.

The shift toward public-private partnerships (PPP) for infrastructure financing reduces fiscal burden and opens recurring revenue streams for toll road operators like SULI and NRCA.

Focus on RLCO and WIRG surges as catalysts for near-term momentum; maintain selective exposure to hospital operators and generic drug makers, as regulatory tailwinds and rising private insurance penetration support structural growth.

DeFi lending and privacy-focused assets (AAVE, XMR) benefit from persistent demand for decentralized credit and censorship-resistant transactions amid global regulatory uncertainty.

AAVE's DeFi lending strength and XMR's privacy narrative add tactical plays. Position for volatility with tight stops.
